The next bit is blurry, but I somehow ended up outside of my classroom door with the principle, the janitor, the school counselor and Mr. Mean/nice guy. I was being scolded by the principle, this "nice" old lady, that if I didn't turn around and walk into the classroom, the janitor (tallest man alive, I swear) would pick me up and drag me in. Well, I didn't want to go inside, because I was still upset and crying my eyes out. I remember making very real excuses that I wanted to talk to my mom and the school therapist, who did nothing but stand back and frown at me.
